\[
40^\circ+x+30^\circ+45^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
x=180^\circ-115^\circ=65^\circ.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\text{Probability}=\frac{65^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac{13}{72}.
